items.summary: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
items.recommend_reason_zh: mksglu/context-mode 为 AI 编程代理优化上下文窗口，沙箱化工具输出、持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 跨平台路由，值得体验。
items.recommend_reason_en: mksglu/context-mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents by sandboxing tool output, persisting session memory, and enforcing routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, reportedly cutting output by 98%, making it worth opening.

items.recommend_reason_zh: MentionBird 把 Ahrefs 式分析思路带到 AI 搜索，适合想体验 AI 搜索分析工具的人打开了解。
items.recommend_reason_en: MentionBird is pitched as Ahrefs for AI Search, pointing to monitoring brand visibility across AI search results, and is worth opening to judge whether that fits your needs.

items.summary: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
items.recommend_reason_zh: cathrynlavery/diagram-design 为 Claude Code 等工具提供44种编辑风图表，输出独立 HTML+SVG，适合想避开 Mermaid 套路的人。
items.recommend_reason_en: Diagram-design provides 44 editorial diagram types as self-contained HTML and SVG for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid and Pi, worth opening for cleaner visuals without Mermaid-style output.

items.summary: Record talking-head videos. Claude Code does the edit.
items.recommend_reason_zh: Takes for Mac 可录制口播视频，由 Claude Code 完成剪辑，想快速制作说话视频值得打开试试。
items.recommend_reason_en: Takes for Mac lets you record talking-head videos and then uses Claude Code to handle the editing, making it worth opening if you want a faster path from raw footage to a finished cut.
